affinity.notes: Chitin and metal define the body; gold strands are secondary environmental accents.

anatomy.notes: Four arms, digitigrade legs, and chitin plates read coherently.

archetype.notes: Assassin or skirmisher does not communicate the intended route-switch controller duty.

counterplay.notes: Lean stance, hooked upper limbs, and exposed narrow torso clearly suggest fast reach attacks and low durability.

finish.notes: Crisp material hierarchy and strong focal face.

framing.notes: Complete centered silhouette with useful breathing room.

identity.notes: Four-armed mantis-like insectoid identifies the Elite Drone form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T3; exact intended tier is T3.
